responsibility: Provides deep alias normalization on top of the new trait solver by folding through types and consts, generating alias-relation and normalizes-to obligations, managing binder placeholders and recursion limits, and offering a diagnostics-oriented variant that normalizes opportunistically without surfacing solver errors.
same_name_distinction: This `normalize.rs` is the new-solver deep-normalization implementation, creating alias-relate/normalizes-to obligations through `solve::FulfillmentCtxt` and also providing a diagnostics-only fallback path, unlike the old-solver and query/type-op normalization files.
